## What this letter says
This letter gives you an appointment. It is for a heart scan (echocardiogram). The scan is an ultrasound scan of the heart. It takes about 45 minutes.

## What you need to do
1. Come on Tuesday 17 November 2026 at 10:40. Go to the Cardiac Investigations Unit, Level 2.
2. Arrive 15 minutes before your appointment time.
3. Bring a list of all the medicines you take.
4. If you cannot come, call 01632 960 123. Call at least 48 hours before. Then another patient can have your slot.
5. You do not need to fast before this test.
6. You do not need to stop any of your medicines.

## Dates and medicines
- Date: Tuesday 17 November 2026 at 10:40.
- Place: Cardiac Investigations Unit, Level 2.
- Length: about 45 minutes.
- Medicines: the letter does not list any medicines.

## Questions to ask your doctor
- What will happen during the echocardiogram?
- Who will tell me the results of the scan?
- What should I do if I need to change my appointment?

## When to get urgent help
The letter does not list specific warning signs.

If you are worried and it is not an emergency, call NHS 111. In an emergency, call 999.

---
*This explanation was made by a computer program to help you read your letter. It may contain mistakes. It does not replace your doctor, nurse or pharmacist. Always follow the letter and ask them if anything is unclear.*
